_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil (score almost never moves ±2 in 12h); no VIX/dvol spike or ETF-flow impulse has printed, so the skilled call is hold inside Complacency until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase but flow print is consistent with non-breakout caution, not a contrary direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54, 30d momentum stays mid-range, no VIX/dvol spike and no sustained positive ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 46 with vol expansion (Anxiety) or F&G/momentum clear 62 with ETF flows turning decisively positive (Disbelief)
